stats.notes: No filled-in Common Data Set found: the 'Gonzaga University CDS 2025-2026' PDF on Institutional Research's reports page is a blank template (no numbers in any table), and no other year is posted, so items found only in a CDS (in-state / out-of-state split, GPA, admission factors, SAT total) are not added. Figures are from Gonzaga's own IPEDS Admissions survey 2025-26 (fall 2025 entering class, first-time degree-seeking): 8,905 applied, 7,091 admitted (79.6%), 1,130 enrolled. 'International' is IPEDS 'U.S. Nonresident': 263 applied, 136 admitted, 18 enrolled. Early action (non-binding): 5,614 applied, 5,054 admitted, 796 enrolled; no early decision. SAT/ACT submit rates are the share of enrolled first-time students whose score was used in the admission decision (218 SAT = 19%, 73 ACT = 6% as printed). Undergraduate enrollment (5,281) and the nonresident count (259) are IPEDS fall 2024 (EF2024); the student-to-faculty ratio of 12 to 1 is College Navigator's.

stats_extra.notes: IPEDS ADM2024 (fall 2024 entering class) via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal: 8,759 applied, 7,155 admitted (81.7%), 1,251 enrolled; the same prior-year figures are printed in Gonzaga's 2025-26 IPEDS report.
